timeline.line: Two 25 bp hikes to 5.75% forecast, as strong growth and 5%+ inflation weigh on bank stocks

Q2 GDP came in well above the RBI's 7% forecast
Rate-hike talk is being cited for the selling in HDFC Bank, SBI and ICICI Bank

timeline.title: Most economists now see an RBI hike Oct 7
timeline.line: 35 of 61 in a Reuters poll expect a 25 bp repo hike to 5.50% at the Oct 5–7 MPC
more: It would be the first increase since February 2023
A majority also see another hike in December
August inflation was 4.82%; the rupee is down about 6% this year
